pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is shallow frying? (1 mark)
   A. Baking in an oven
   B. Cooking in water
   C. Cooking in a lot of deep oil
   D. Cooking in a small amount of hot oil in a pan

2. Which PPE is thrown away rather than washed? (1 mark)
   A. A paper dust mask
   B. Canvas shoes
   C. An overall
   D. A cloth mask

3. Why should you bathe every day? (1 mark)
   A. To remove sweat, dirt and germs
   B. To make skin dry
   C. To make the body hot
   D. To waste water

4. Which animal is kept mainly for wool? (1 mark)
   A. Donkey
   B. Hen
   C. Wool sheep
   D. Goat

5. What word means living peacefully together with wild animals? (1 mark)
   A. Poaching
   B. Hunting
   C. Coexisting
   D. Trapping

6. Why do we crack an egg into a bowl first? (1 mark)
   A. To make it grow
   B. To check it and remove bits of shell
   C. To cook it
   D. To make it hot

7. Which is a way of protecting ripe fruit from birds and monkeys? (1 mark)
   A. Poison the animals
   B. Cover trees with nets or use scare methods
   C. Cut the tree
   D. Leave them ripe for months

8. How should drinking water be stored? (1 mark)
   A. In a clean container with a lid
   B. In an open basin
   C. On the ground
   D. With a dirty cup

9. Which nutrient do body-building foods supply? (1 mark)
   A. Protein
   B. Fibre only
   C. Water
   D. Salt

10. What is one purpose of tacking? (1 mark)
   A. To wash cloth
   B. To iron cloth
   C. To cut cloth
   D. To hold layers of cloth together before sewing

11. What is personal protective equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Tools for digging
   B. Food for health
   C. Clothing and gear worn to protect the body
   D. Soap for cleaning

12. What is the first step in cleaning gumboots? (1 mark)
   A. Knock off lumps of mud outside
   B. Store them wet
   C. Put them in the fire
   D. Dry them in strong sun

13. Why do we mix tiny seeds with dry sand? (1 mark)
   A. To kill germs
   B. To spread them thinly and evenly
   C. To make them heavy
   D. To make them wet

14. What should you do at the end of a sewing lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Leave them
   B. Hide them
   C. Count the needles and pins
   D. Throw them

15. Which disease can result from drinking unsafe water? (1 mark)
   A. Sunburn
   B. A cut
   C. Toothache
   D. Cholera

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain four ways in which wild animals help people or the environment. (4 marks)

17. Name three foods that can be shallow fried. (3 marks)

18. Explain the difference between green and brown materials for compost, with an example of each. (3 marks)

19. How can a family get a balanced meal cheaply? (2 marks)

20. Give three reasons why PPE should be cleaned. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Cooking in a small amount of hot oil in a pan
   Shallow frying uses a thin layer of oil.

2. A — A paper dust mask
   Disposable masks should not be washed.

3. A — To remove sweat, dirt and germs
   Bathing keeps the body clean.

4. C — Wool sheep
   Some sheep breeds have wool.

5. C — Coexisting
   To coexist is to live together.

6. B — To check it and remove bits of shell
   You avoid a bad egg spoiling the pan.

7. B — Cover trees with nets or use scare methods
   Peaceful protection.

8. A — In a clean container with a lid
   Covering keeps germs out.

9. A — Protein
   Protein builds muscles.

10. D — To hold layers of cloth together before sewing
   Tacking keeps layers in place.

11. C — Clothing and gear worn to protect the body
   PPE protects us from harm.

12. A — Knock off lumps of mud outside
   This removes the dirt before washing.

13. B — To spread them thinly and evenly
   Sand helps prevent clumps of seeds.

14. C — Count the needles and pins
   Counting ensures none is lost.

15. D — Cholera
   Cholera spreads through dirty water.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Birds eat insects; bees pollinate; animals spread seeds; wildlife brings tourists and money.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eggs, fish, sausages, onions, chapati (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each food.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Green materials are fresh and wet such as fresh grass or peelings. Brown materials are dry such as dry leaves or straw.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 mark for correct examples.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Grow vegetables and fruits at home and use cheap proteins such as beans, omena or eggs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: It can carry germs, it may smell or spoil, and clean PPE lasts longer and protects better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.
